steps.subject: sky
steps.action: tap phthalo blue into the brush and crisscross the sky

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: add a little more blue and crisscross the sky
steps.rule: color is hard to take off so start with a little

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: darken the sky a bit for the clouds
steps.where: a darker sky makes white clouds stand out

steps.subject: water
steps.action: add green to the dirty brush and pull water in from outside
steps.load: a tiny bit of green beaten into the bristles
steps.motion: pull from outside in, bottom up
steps.rule: it mixes with liquid white and lightens toward the horizon
steps.new: leaves an open gap for a light sheen

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: lay in a cloud base with titanium white and a little permanent red
steps.load: small amount of permanent red in lots of white

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend and fluff the cloud base with big circles
steps.where: lower part of cloud, top untouched

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: add a second cloud with more white and red
steps.load: more paint loaded onto the brush
steps.rule: working one spot too long makes clouds look like cotton balls

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: mix the dark mountain color
steps.load: equal parts with a little crimson and white

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: dab a distant mountain with the corner of the fan brush
steps.load: lighter mix loaded on the fan brush

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap mist softly at the base of the distant mountain

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: push a dark mountain shape in with the knife
steps.load: dark color loaded on the knife

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull the mountain down with the big brush
steps.rule: pulling down lightens the base as white mixes in

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: touch a light white highlight along the mountain
steps.motion: touch and let it follow the mountain
steps.rule: too much pressure is the biggest mistake

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: shadow side with blue and white on the knife
steps.load: roll of blue and white on the knife
steps.rule: shadows fall at the opposite angle from highlights

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap mist at the mountain base with a clean dry large brush
steps.motion: tap along the angles then lift gently
steps.rule: lifting blends out the tap marks

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: break up the straight edge with white and add a shadow
steps.rule: a line that is too straight looks wrong

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: foothill with sap green added to the dark mix
steps.load: lots of paint loaded on the fan

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: dab evergreen trees with the fan brush

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: make foothills smaller toward the end and lift up
steps.where: toward the end of the foothills
steps.rule: smaller shapes make the distance look farther

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull reflections down with a light touch
steps.rule: a wet canvas lets reflections slide easily

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add small white trunk marks

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: layer sap green and cadmium yellow in the background
steps.load: thinner added, lots of paint loaded
steps.motion: touch and bend up in layers

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: cut in straight white water lines
steps.rule: lines must stay straight or the water runs out

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: soften excess paint with a clean knife
steps.rule: mixes with the color underneath and softens

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: dab dark trees back and forth with the corner of the fan
steps.load: lots of dark mix loaded on the fan
steps.motion: corner the brush and go back and forth

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add more dark trees on the right side
steps.motion: back and forth with the corner

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: add a big tree with the big brush and sap green mix
steps.load: mixed on the brush and loaded deep
steps.rule: odd numbers make a better composition

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: reflect the tree color down into the water

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: add trunk marks with burnt umber and white

steps.subject: leaf tree
steps.action: highlight trees with sap green and cadmium yellow from the right
steps.rule: light comes from the right so highlights go right

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: drop in bushes with yellow ochre and sap green
steps.load: loaded while the brush is wet

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add permanent red to the bushes and reflect them

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: drop in a purple bush on the right side
steps.load: mixed on the brush, paint thinner added
steps.rule: thinning without diluting the color keeps it strong

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: pull the large brush down for reflections

steps.subject: land
steps.action: add land with brown and a touch of white
steps.load: brown mixed on palette, liquid white for highlight

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: cut sticks and twigs with the knife point
steps.rule: breaks up the area and adds depth

steps.subject: path
steps.action: lay a path back and forth with brown

steps.subject: bush
steps.action: add bushes over the path on the other side
steps.motion: drop in and let them hang over
steps.rule: put the path in first so bushes overlap it

steps.subject: trunk/limbs
steps.action: scrape sticks and twigs with the knife to finish
